title: Fujita 1997 AF radial tensile tangent modulus by region and grade

quantity.name: tangent modulus
quantity.definition: slope of best-fit linear region (moving regression)

source.authors: Fujita Y, Duncan NA, Lotz JC
source.sample: 183 analysed radial AF strips (196 tested) from 15 lumbar discs (L1-L2 to L4-L5) of 8 cadaveric spines; 8 grade I and 7 grade II discs

protocol.summary: Radial AF strips (1.0 x 3.2 mm nominal cross-section, ~10 mm long, gauge length 3.3+-1.1 mm) cut with vibratome/razor die from mid-transverse plane of anterior and posterolateral quadrants, inner/middle/outer regions; sandpaper/frame grips; physiologic saline; distracted to failure at 1 mm/min (~0.5 %/s; rate 0.005-50 %/s had no significant effect). Nominal stress = load / as-cut area; strain = grip displacement / gauge length. Tangent modulus = best-r2 moving linear regression; yield by 5% offset; ultimate = max load; toe fit sigma = A(exp(B e) - 1) to 70% yield strain (AB = initial modulus).
how_to_simulate: Model a radial AF strip 1.0 x 3.2 mm cross-section, ~3.3 mm gauge, loaded radially (perpendicular to lamellae)
Report nominal stress-strain: tangent modulus (linear region), yield (5% offset) and ultimate stress/strain

extraction.check_notes: Tables 1-2 read from 200-dpi render. Grade II = moderately degenerated in this paper (Thompson); rows pooled over grades I+II except the grade rows. Strains converted to % (x100). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
